chunks: "What an excellent house the bathhouse is: in it the Fire is remembered, and it removes filth."

key_terms.أَمِيرُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Title of Imam 'Ali عليه السلام, the Commander of the Faithful
key_terms.الدَّرَنِ: Filth, grime, or dirt removed through washing
key_terms.النَّارُ: The Fire, meaning Hellfire as a reminder for reflection
key_terms.الْحَمَّامُ: The bathhouse, a place for washing and cleansing

ai.seo_question: Why did Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام describe the bathhouse as a good place?
ai.summary: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام praises the bathhouse as a beneficial place because it combines bodily cleanliness with spiritual reflection. Its heat reminds one of the Fire, while its washing removes filth from the body.
